parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment only vaguely mentions "Alg." without a specific algorithm number and references "the beginning of the paper" in broad terms, so the authors cannot confidently determine which exact part of the paper is being addressed; this constitutes weak grounding rather than full grounding. Moreover, the comment is an incomplete sentence: it merely says "Some ablation studies on each component in Alg." without specifying which components or what exactly needs to be addressed, so the claim that it clearly specifies the issue is not well supported. Since the comment does not detail what is wrong or missing in the referenced part, it cannot be considered specific about what needs to be addressed. Overall, the comment suffers from both a vague reference to the relevant part and a truncated, underspecified suggestion, which are the key deficiencies to weigh when assessing grounding and specificity.
